Debt payoff: snowball vs avalanche

A month-by-month plan to clear several debts, comparing the snowball and avalanche methods.

What you enter

  • Your debts
  • Total you can pay each month
  • Method

How this is calculated

  • Every month: add interest, pay each minimum, then put the rest of the budget on the target debt.
  • Avalanche targets the highest interest rate; snowball targets the smallest balance.
